author: musho7-dev
subject: Workshop: preview parts before buying, confirm with BUY
body:
Tapping a part you don't own now only previews it on the car (stats
update too) and opens a "Buy <part> for N coins?" bar with BUY and
Cancel. Coins are spent only on BUY; if you can't afford it the bar
says how many more coins you need. Owned parts still equip on tap.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
